Fair.

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##

South or Southeast 3 or 4, veering South or Southwest overnight into Monday, increasing 4 or 5 on Monday morning, them 5 or 6 later in the day.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches soon developing. Rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor and falling very poor in fog patches.
